name: Zendesk Sell
label: Zendesk Sell — Sales CRM API v2 (not Support)
description: Official Zendesk Sell (Sales CRM, formerly Base) REST API v2 at https://api.getbase.com/v2. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Not Zendesk Support. Bearer OAuth access token (or dashboard personal token) from a Sell OAuth app. Leads, contacts, and deals are PII. Customer owns the Sell account. Minimize; never log access_token, emails, or phones. trigger.listen is BPMN message-event ingress. Docs: https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/sales-crm/introduction/
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Create/update take first_name, last_name, organization_name, name, email, phone, contact_id, value, content, resource_type, … (nested as data.*). Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"lead.create","last_name":"Ada"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: lead.create | lead.get | lead.list | lead.update | contact.create | contact.get | contact.list | contact.update | deal.create | deal.get | deal.list | deal.update | deal.delete | note.create | task.create | task.get | pipeline.list | stage.list | trigger.listen.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Record id for get/update/delete path {id}.

schema.label: page
schema.description: List page. Starts at 1.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: List page size. Default 25; max 100.

schema.label: sort_by
schema.description: List sort field. Append :desc for descending.

schema.label: ids
schema.description: Comma-separated ids filter.

schema.label: owner_id
schema.description: Owner user id. List filter on lead/contact/deal.list; also create/update body (data.owner_id). Example: 1.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Email. List filter on lead.list / contact.list; also lead/contact create/update body (data.email). PII — do not log. Example: mark@designservices.com.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Lead status. lead.list filter and lead.create/update body (data.status). Example: Unqualified.

schema.label: stage_id
schema.description: Deal stage id. deal.list filter and deal.create/update body (data.stage_id). Example: 1.

schema.label: pipeline_id
schema.description: stage.list pipeline filter.

schema.label: first_name
schema.description: Given name. lead.create/update (individual); contact.create/update when is_organization=false. Example: Mark. Nested as data.first_name. https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/sales-crm/resources/leads/

schema.label: last_name
schema.description: Family name. Required on lead.create when organization_name is empty; required on contact.create when is_organization=false. Example: Johnson. Nested as data.last_name.

schema.label: organization_name
schema.description: Organization name. Required on lead.create when last_name is empty. Example: Design Services Company. Nested as data.organization_name.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Contact organization name (contact.create when is_organization=true) or deal name (deal.create required). Example: Website Redesign. Nested as data.name.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: Phone. lead/contact create/update. PII — do not log. Example: 508-778-6516. Nested as data.phone.

schema.label: mobile
schema.description: Mobile phone. lead/contact create/update. Example: 508-778-6516. Nested as data.mobile.

schema.label: fax
schema.description: Fax. lead/contact create/update. Example: +44-208-1234567. Nested as data.fax.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Job title. lead/contact create/update. Example: CEO. Nested as data.title.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Notes. lead/contact create/update. Example: I know him via Tom. Nested as data.description.

schema.label: industry
schema.description: Industry. lead/contact create/update. Example: Design Services. Nested as data.industry.

schema.label: website
schema.description: Website. lead/contact create/update. Example: designservices.com. Nested as data.website.

schema.label: twitter
schema.description: Twitter handle. lead/contact create/update. Example: mjohnson. Nested as data.twitter.

schema.label: facebook
schema.description: Facebook handle. lead/contact create/update. Nested as data.facebook.

schema.label: linkedin
schema.description: LinkedIn handle. lead/contact create/update. Nested as data.linkedin.

schema.label: skype
schema.description: Skype handle. lead/contact create/update. Nested as data.skype.

schema.label: source_id
schema.description: Source id. lead/deal create/update. Example: 10. Nested as data.source_id.

schema.label: address
schema.description: Address {line1,city,postal_code,state,country}. lead/contact create/update. Nested as data.address.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Tag names. JSON array of strings. lead/contact/deal/note create/update. Example: ["important"]. Nested as data.tags.

schema.label: custom_fields
schema.description: Custom field map. lead/contact/deal create/update. Example: {"known_via":"tom"}. Nested as data.custom_fields.

schema.label: is_organization
schema.description: contact.create only. true = organization (requires name); false = individual (requires last_name). Cannot change later. Nested as data.is_organization.

schema.label: parent_organization_id
schema.description: Parent organization contact id. contact.create/update when is_organization=true. Nested as data.parent_organization_id.

schema.label: customer_status
schema.description: contact.create/update. Example: none | current. Nested as data.customer_status.

schema.label: prospect_status
schema.description: contact.create/update. Example: none | current. Nested as data.prospect_status.

schema.label: contact_id
schema.description: Deal contact id. Required on deal.create. Example: 1. Nested as data.contact_id.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Deal value. Prefer two decimal places. deal.create/update. Example: 1000. Nested as data.value.

schema.label: currency
schema.description: ISO 4217 currency for deal.create/update. Default account currency. Example: USD. Nested as data.currency.

schema.label: hot
schema.description: Deal hot flag. deal.create/update. Nested as data.hot.

schema.label: estimated_close_date
schema.description: Deal estimated close date YYYY-MM-DD. deal.create/update. Example: 2024-12-31. Nested as data.estimated_close_date.

schema.label: customized_win_likelihood
schema.description: Deal win likelihood 0-100. deal.create/update. Nested as data.customized_win_likelihood.

schema.label: loss_reason_id
schema.description: Deal loss reason id. deal.create/update. Nested as data.loss_reason_id.

schema.label: resource_type
schema.description: note.create / task.create attachment. EXACT: lead | contact | deal. Example: lead. Nested as data.resource_type.

schema.label: resource_id
schema.description: Id of the lead/contact/deal the note or task attaches to. Required on note.create. Example: 1. Nested as data.resource_id.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Note or task text. Required on note.create and task.create. Example: Contact Tom. Nested as data.content.

schema.label: is_important
schema.description: Star the note. note.create. Nested as data.is_important.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Note permission type. EXACT: regular | restricted. note.create. Example: regular. Nested as data.type.

schema.label: due_date
schema.description: Task due datetime UTC ISO8601. task.create. Example: 2014-09-27T16:32:56Z. Nested as data.due_date.

schema.label: remind_at
schema.description: Task reminder datetime UTC ISO8601; must be before due_date. task.create. Nested as data.remind_at.

schema.label: completed
schema.description: Task completed flag. task.create. Nested as data.completed.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. May contain PII — never log values.
